lexicalAdmission.unitType: stable predicate and second half of an inherited birth formula
lexicalAdmission.boundaryRuling: Most witnesses use 未出母胎，度人已畢, but the shorter predicate is not an accidental clipping. Poshan Haiming independently asks about 'thirty-six years later, the work of delivering people already complete' (三十六年後度人已畢), applying the four-character predicate outside the before-birth formula. Other masters syntactically extend and interpret the second half. Keep the shorter entry, but prominently bind and redirect the full fixed formula.
lexicalAdmission.fullFormulaTarget: before leaving the womb, the work of liberating people was already complete
lexicalAdmission.rejectedAlternative: Do not expand the headword mechanically to the full formula: the Poshan witness establishes standalone active reuse.

semanticRuling.preferredTarget: the work of liberating people was already complete
alternateTargets: the work of delivering people was already complete
searchAliases: before leaving the womb the work was complete
semanticRuling.explanation: 度人已畢 says that the work of liberating people was already complete. It most often forms the second half of 未出母胎，度人已畢: before leaving the womb, the work was done. Zhongfeng Mingben and Foyan Qingyuan use the inherited line to put activity before the narrated birth; Miyun Yuanwu applies its two halves to dependence on parents and teachers; Wunian You pairs it with teaching already complete before the mouth opens; Feiyin Tongrong treats it as an inability to conceal what is already present; and Poshan Haiming independently reapplies the shorter predicate to thirty-six years of a teacher's life.
semanticRuling.note: 度人 literally concerns bringing or carrying people across and conventionally means delivering or liberating them. Preserve the completed-action force of 已畢. The phrase does not mean that a later teaching career historically ended before birth; the retained masters use and test the inherited formula as a temporal reversal.

exactActor.grammarEvidence: Zhongfeng's continuous bathing-the-Buddha hall address introduces the inherited formula with 所以云 and then asks whether this message existed before the eighth day of the fourth month.

caseDecisions.semanticContribution: Uses the complete formula and actively questions its relation to the narrated birth date.

exactActor.grammarEvidence: Foyan's continuous 上堂 voice says 所以釋迦老子未離兜率已降王宮未出母胎度人已畢 and draws out a capping verse.

caseDecisions.semanticContribution: Places the complete predicate in the inherited pre-birth formula and develops it in the hall address.

exactActor.grammarEvidence: Miyun's own hall address says 未出母胎，度人已畢 and immediately interprets its second half with 豈從師長成立.

caseDecisions.semanticContribution: Makes the completed-delivery half answer to the claim that one is established by teachers.

exactActor.grammarEvidence: Wunian's continuous letter says 未出母胎，度人已畢；未開口時，說法已週, adding his own parallel completed-before-beginning clause.

caseDecisions.semanticContribution: Pairs delivery complete before birth with teaching complete before speaking, confirming the completed-action reading.

exactActor.grammarEvidence: 世尊未離兜率已降王宮未出母胎度人已畢 is the repeated 頌古 case heading; the following verse is separately authored and does not repeat the exact headword.

caseDecisions.reason: Confirms the stable full formula but supplies no independent headword-bearing actor or active exact-term deployment.

exactActor.grammarEvidence: 問 directly governs 三十六年後度人已畢; Poshan Haiming responds with a blow.

caseDecisions.semanticContribution: Decisive boundary witness: reuses 度人已畢 outside 未出母胎 as a predicate applied to thirty-six years later.

exactActor.grammarEvidence: Feiyin says 釋迦老子云 and quotes the complete formula, then judges it as 布袋盛錐，固自藏鋒不得.

caseDecisions.semanticContribution: Actively comments that the already-complete activity cannot be concealed.

exactActor.grammarEvidence: The monk asks how awakening on seeing the morning star accords with 又說未出母胎，度人已畢; Muchen Daomin answers.

caseDecisions.reason: Legitimate independent question, but it repeats the full formula without adding lexical evidence beyond the six stronger retained families.

exactActor.grammarEvidence: 頌古 introduces 世尊未離兜率，已降王宮；未出母胎，度人已畢 as the case heading. Wanru Tongwei's following verse varies it as 母胎度人畢 but does not contain the exact headword.

caseDecisions.reason: The authored variant is a useful boundary research lead, but the exact extracted headword belongs only to passive case metadata and cannot pad defining depth.

retainedSubset.floorRuling: Six independent active Tier-2 families meet the floor. Two passive 頌古 headings and one semantically redundant question are excluded. No duplicate formula recensions are counted merely for repeating the inherited line.
